## Whoami

Bioinformatician working where virology meets genomics. PhD student in Genetics and Molecular Biology at the **Universidade Estadual de Santa Cruz** (UESC), in Ilhéus, Bahia — the same program where I finished my master's.

Most of my work comes down to one idea: the viruses are already in the data, and somebody has to go look. I build the tools that make that search routine.

## Research

**Viral discovery and surveillance from public data.** Mining RNA-Seq libraries deposited for entirely different purposes, and recovering the viral sequences hiding in them.

**Metagenomics and metatranscriptomics.** Characterizing viral diversity across hosts — plants, arthropods and fermentation-associated microbial communities.

**Endogenous viral elements and small RNAs.** Tracing ancient viral integrations in bee genomes, and the small RNA pathways that respond to infection.

**Plant immunity.** Identification of resistance genes in *Theobroma cacao*, and the study of their expression under various conditions.

## Education

### PhD in Genetics and Molecular Biology

Universidade Estadual de Santa Cruz · Ilhéus, BA · 2025 — present

Building the next generation of *ViralQuest*, and extending viral discovery to new hosts and datasets.

### MSc in Genetics and Molecular Biology

Universidade Estadual de Santa Cruz · Ilhéus, BA · 2023 — 2025

Emphasis on bioinformatics. Viral genomic surveillance of *Theobroma cacao* using public data, screening putative novel viral sequences across RNA-Seq libraries.

### BSc in Interdisciplinary Sciences

Universidade Federal do Sul da Bahia · Itabuna, BA · 2018 — 2022

## Skills

**Sequencing data** — NGS analysis; genome and transcriptome assembly and curation; differential expression; gene set enrichment (GSEA); small RNA analysis.

**Engineering** — bioinformatics pipeline development; reproducible environments with Docker and pixi; data mining from public sequence repositories; Linux server administration for research.

**Languages** — R, Python and Bash, with Git and GitHub for everything.

## Software

### [viralquest](https://github.com/gabrielvpina/viralquest)

An interactive, accessible pipeline for viral sequence analysis and curation. Designed so that finding viruses in a contig set does not require being a bioinformatician first. *Published in BMC Bioinformatics.*

### [viralfetch](https://github.com/gabrielvpina/viralfetch)

Query and download viral taxonomy, metadata and sequences — the tedious part of every virome project, automated.

### [slin](https://github.com/gabrielvpina/slin)

A terminal interface for the SLURM workload manager, for people who live on a cluster.

### [dataViz](https://github.com/gabrielvpina/dataViz)

Figures and visualizations from published papers, kept in the open so the plots are reproducible.

## Publications

Work on cocoa viromes, bee endogenous viral elements, stingless bee miRNAs and the ViralQuest pipeline itself — the full list lives on the [publications page](../publications/).
